description: Land Aquisition - Bellapitiya, Madurawala D/S Devision, Kalutara  District. Warakagoda, Madurawala D/S Devision, Kalutara District.
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, providing detailed information about specific land parcels being acquired by the government for public purposes, including land descriptions, locations, claimants, and extents. The content falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land acquisitions, property ownership transfers, and land registration matters.
